model_id: MultiFlow released checkpoint last.ckpt (Zenodo 10714631 weights.tar.gz, md5 e7460c552897931380c15c697be5c0c1)

settings.input: sequence only (forward_folding=True, separate_t=True: amino-acid types fixed to the input)
settings.integrator: Euler ODE (do_sde False), min_t 0.01, self-conditioning on
settings.batching: padded-batch port of Interpolant.sample; validated against MultiFlow's own sampler on short chains only (L 81-85): max CA deviation 0.10 A at 500 steps
settings.nonstandard_residues: mapped to index 20 (X = MASK in MultiFlow); the sampler unmasks them to a random amino acid (native behaviour)
settings.duplicate_sequences: targets with identical sequence share one prediction

hardware: NVIDIA H200, shared with other jobs
timing_note: seconds/peak_mem in this file are NOT per-target (booked on the first chain of each batch); real numbers from batches.rank*.jsonl: 15-54 s per chain on shared GPUs, peak 12.5 GB (L=1414 took 311 s)
training_data_cutoff: not stated in README/configs (paper not checked); trained on PDB monomers of length 60-384 plus synthetic distillation structures; their test split is named pdb_post2021

reproduction_gate.outcome: not reproduced (their test set is downloaded at $P/tr/multiflow_testset and a script is ready at $P/tr/multiflow_tools/repro_testset.py, but it was not run)

sanity.scorer: python/eval/metrics.py all_metrics on CA, residues with finite ref coords
